mapper.select: SELECT id,buyer_user_id buyer_id,factory_id,requirement_status state,version,requirement_no number,requirement_title title,usage_scene,expected_completion_date, delivery_city,delivery_preference delivery_mode,remark,budget_range_fen budget,response_deadline_at deadline,latest_reason reason,updated_at FROM custom_requirement WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,version,requirement_no number,requirement_title title,factory_id,requirement_status state,updated_at FROM custom_requirement WHERE factory_id=#{factory} AND requirement_status!='draft'buyer_user_id=#{buyer} AND requirement_status=#{status} ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id LIMIT #{page.pageSize} OFFSET #{page.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM custom_requirement WHERE factory_id=#{factory} AND requirement_status!='draft'buyer_user_id=#{buyer} AND requirement_status=#{status}

SELECT id,source_sku_id,item_title title,quantity,dimension_requirement dimension,material_requirement material,style_requirement style,acceptance_notes FROM custom_requirement_item WHERE requirement_id=#{id} ORDER BY sort_no
SELECT requirement_item_id item_id,material_id,file_name name,attachment_type type FROM custom_requirement_attachment WHERE requirement_id=#{id} ORDER BY sort_no

SELECT id,quote_version,quote_status state,spec_snapshot_json terms,custom_goods_amount_fen goods_fen,total_amount_fen total_fen,valid_until FROM custom_quote WHERE requirement_id=#{id} AND published_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY quote_version DESC
SELECT id FROM custom_order WHERE requirement_id=#{id}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM factory_profile f JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=f.owner_user_id WHERE f.id=#{id} AND f.factory_status='active' AND u.user_status='active')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM prop_sku WHERE id=#{id} AND factory_id=#{factory})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO custom_quote(id,quote_no,requirement_id,factory_id,quote_version,quote_status,custom_goods_amount_fen,delivery_fee_fen,total_amount_fen, production_days,promised_completion_date,spec_snapshot_json,quote_remark,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{id},CONCAT('CQ',#{id}),#{root},#{factory},#{sequence},'draft',#{goods},#{quoteTerms.freightFen},#{total},#{quoteTerms.productionDays},#{quoteTerms.promisedDate},#{terms},#{quoteTerms.remark},#{at},#{at}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE custom_goods_amount_fen=#{goods},delivery_fee_fen=#{quoteTerms.freightFen},total_amount_fen=#{total},production_days=#{quoteTerms.productionDays}, promised_completion_date=#{quoteTerms.promisedDate},spec_snapshot_json=#{terms},quote_remark=#{quoteTerms.remark},updated_at=#{at}
mapper.update: UPDATE custom_quote SET quote_status='published',published_at=#{at},valid_until=DATE_ADD(CAST(#{at} AS DATETIME(3)),INTERVAL 72 HOUR),updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND quote_status='draft'
UPDATE custom_quote SET quote_status=#{state},updated_at=#{at} WHERE requirement_id=#{root} AND quote_status='published'
UPDATE custom_quote SET quote_status='superseded',updated_at=#{at} WHERE requirement_id=#{root} AND quote_status='draft'
UPDATE custom_quote SET quote_status='accepted',accepted_at=#{at},updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND quote_status='published'
